cities.subtitle: Le dome monumental et ses petits quartiers
cities.description: Un dome immense domine des maisons toutes a la meme echelle humaine, reliees par un chemin et un petit pont.
cities.request: Corriger proprement toute l'echelle des maisons autour du dome, beaucoup trop grandes ; pas une retouche de remplissage.
cities.edit:
ARBORIUM: PRIORITY IS A GENUINE SCALE CORRECTION. The current timber houses flanking the dome are grossly oversized, not approved. COMPLETELY REMOVE AND REDRAW BOTH HOUSE GROUPS at a much smaller scale; do NOT keep the existing house silhouettes, roof heights or footprints. Preserve the immense low ribbed glass/wood dome and the forest-light identity, not the erroneous surrounding buildings.
The dome shelters a whole city and is several hundred meters across. At this same middle distance, an ordinary 1-2 floor cottage must be only about 1/40 to 1/60 of the dome DIAMETER in width and 1/25 to 1/40 of the dome HEIGHT, small believable 6-9 meter buildings. In this 1672x941 composition the dome is roughly 800 pixels wide; ordinary houses beside it should read approximately 14-22 pixels wide and 10-17 pixels high, NOT the current 100-200 pixel giant mansions. This is a decisive reduction, not shrinking them by a token 10%. A handful of modest grouped buildings only. Keep all buildings near the dome on the SAME middle-distance plane; no huge closer house justified by exaggerated wide-angle perspective. All small house doors, the dome's actual tiny entrance, railings, steps, gardens and any almost-dot figures follow ONE consistent human scale. A house's door is roughly a person's height; a human is not 1/50 of a normal cottage door. A larger structural rib arch is NOT a gigantic usable door.
Recompose the ENTIRE lower clearing, paths and stream coherently around this scale: normal narrow walking paths, one modest stone footbridge with human-height balustrade, one continuous meandering river following the valley. Correct any oversized bridge/rail/stair as necessary; do not paste miniature houses into unadjusted giant gardens. Two small neighborhood clusters with paths leading to the dome entry, open natural meadow and connected forest banks between. No rows of ornate decorative pavilions, no giant mansion near the camera. Keep dome silhouette, warm light and big natural forest backdrop; a clear panoramic settlement overview rather than a foreground cottage portrait. Surroundings must read as a genuinely small human town beside an ENORMOUS dome. Rebuild from a consistent scale plan, do not add objects.
cities.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE COMPLETELY NEW Kalistar city panorama with a CORRECT MONUMENTAL SCALE PLAN. Do not reuse a previous layout or cottage design. Horizontal 16:9 painted environmental illustration, no text, frame, collage, watermark or logo.
REFERENCE ROLES: Images 1 Momo and 2 Valazar provide Kalistar narrative PAINTING STYLE ONLY: tactile brushwork, painted volumes, selective edges, warm material wear; do not import their characters or ruin scenery. Image 3 is the accepted ARBORIUM DOME ARCHITECTURE ONLY: low hemispherical botanical dome with curved living-wood ribs and transparent glass, pointed small finial, circular stone foot. Do not use the icon's sepia medium; full color painted green forest and warm wood/pearl glass.
ARBORIUM is an IMMENSE CITY-SIZED BOTANICAL DOME, approximately 700-800 meters across, several hundred meters high, containing a visible forest canopy and miniature inhabited garden districts. This is not a greenhouse pavilion beside ordinary large cottages. The dome occupies about 65 percent of the image width and is the overwhelmingly dominant landmark, on a broad continuous valley floor with a small raised circular foundation.
KEY SCALE: ordinary houses are 6-9 meters wide and 4-6 meters high. At the SAME DISTANCE as the dome base, each exterior house is only about ONE EIGHTIETH of the dome diameter. In the illustration these homes are TINY painted roof/window marks, around 10-15 pixels wide relative to a 1000-pixel-wide dome, not detailed close-up timber villas. Put TWO SMALL CLUSTERS of 8-12 such tiny homes near the dome base; each WHOLE cluster occupies less than a single broad ribbed glass panel, not one house per huge panel. No ordinary house anywhere larger than about 1/50 of the dome width. Trees at that distance are about 25-35 meters, only a few house widths, not as tall as the dome. Glass structural ribs are immense compared with a person's doorway. Actual pedestrian entry is one almost-dot-sized human opening at the circular foot, NOT the big decorative rib arch. One door, one person and house windows all follow the SAME 2-meter human module. The entry is not the height of a whole house.
COMPOSITION: generous elevated forest overlook, all inhabited districts in the MIDDLE DISTANCE at the same scale plane as the dome base, no enlarged foreground home, no wide-angle cottage. A continuous natural river bends along the valley floor past the dome with ONE small human-scale crossing; tiny paths from the clustered houses meet the ring promenade and tiny doorway. Footbridge and railing are proportionate to the little houses, not a huge castle bridge. Near foreground limited to soft natural forest edge and rock, no buildings, cabins, farms or huge manmade props. Forested slopes frame the valley and fade into a quiet green ridge, no distant castles or decorative towers. A continuous coherent landscape, not scattered model buildings in random patches. Warm dappled daylight, deep living greens, aged copper/wood dome ribs, pearl translucent glass. The visual impression MUST be a huge biosphere containing a city with a TINY human town beside it. No 3D/photography, no giant cottage, no arbitrary decorative filler. A completely rebuilt coherent environment.

cities.subtitle: La cite dans la grande cascade
cities.description: La cite des Cerelf s'etire contre une longue paroi de cascade continue, autour de sa cathedrale et des deux arbres reunis.
cities.request: Moins d'effet d'iles, davantage une ville dans une immense cascade etiree ; conserver les arbres reunis et la cathedrale.
cities.edit:
WOODLAND: The current collection of little rocky islands in a turquoise basin is WRONG. Recompose the geography as ONE LONG CONTINUOUS FORESTED CLIFF / WATERFALL ESCARPMENT with the Cerelf city integrated INTO THE GREAT EXTENDED CASCADE. The inhabited cliff runs diagonally across most of the frame, continuous solid rock and soil, backed by the great forest. The city stretches HORIZONTALLY along its waterfall terraces rather than forming a compact island mound.
Preserve the magnificent pale organic cathedral-waterfall and TWO colossal antler-like diagonal tree trunks MEETING AT ONE COMMON ROOT BASE near the upper central terrace. Cathedral remains between them. Their roots sit firmly in the connected upper cliff, never on separate waterbound islets. Below, an immense broad cascade extends along the same cliff face: successive water curtains, ledges and a main central flow all supplied by one visible upper river/rock basin and draining to one lower riverbed. Elegant ivory living-wood galleries, a few inhabited arcades and supported stairways are built into/along the continuous rocky banks beside and behind the falling water, some recessed behind veils of cascade. Buildings have actual foundations and consistent door scale; walking routes connect along stable dry shelves. Keep the beautiful waterfall architecture and forest sunlight.
The LOWER FOREGROUND is one long stream channel hugging the cliff foot and a continuous near bank, NOT an ocean lake dotted with rocky islets. Remove the separate mini-islands, scattered standalone rock pedestals, random little temples and bridges connecting unrelated waterbound mounds. Only bridge real gaps in the continuous cliff paths; no necklace of tiny islands. Large readable flowing topography and water, quiet forested background, no distant castle filling, no extra decoration. This must feel like a inhabited city within a vast elongated waterfall, not an archipelago or a theme-park island.

cities.subtitle: Les quartiers rocheux de la caldeira
cities.description: Quelques quartiers varies suivent les parois du volcan, separes par de grandes zones de basalte nu.
cities.request: Supprimer la repetition et le patchwork de remplissage des parois ; conserver la cite et le volcan.
cities.edit:
VULKAR: KEEP the accepted city inside the enormous caldera, central horned palace, black lake, lava, depth, gray/ember light and strong basalt silhouette. The repeated tiny house/arch/window patterns plastered over the walls are NOT approved. Rebuild the RESIDENTIAL RIM WALLS AND SECONDARY FILLER as real geology and a few individually designed inhabited districts.
Remove the evenly repeated rows of identical little arches, the glowing window-dot carpet and the look of copy-pasted stone chunks. Leave MOST of the upper wall as BARE NATURAL BASALT: continuous weathered strata, a few large faults and variations of cliff angle, no tile-like repeated texture or additional towers at every corner. Put homes in only THREE irregular modest clusters on genuine stable shelves, each cluster with a different coherent plan responding to its ledge: partly recessed dwellings, a few low basalt roofs, one shared landing. These are small normal houses beside the huge palace, not identical miniature palaces. Their doors and windows share a consistent human scale under perspective, varied silhouettes not random scale. Real stair routes carved into the cliff connect them to existing city terraces; do not draw a bridge or stair without endpoints.
Simplify repetitive nonessential archwork in the outermost neighborhoods as needed, preserve the central palace and the important bridges. Retain broad NEGATIVE SPACE of dark rock between districts, especially on the far wall. No new dense residential ring, duplicated modules, evenly scattered ornaments or orange dots to occupy blank rock. No blur or haze smearing to disguise repeated detail. A restrained architectural/geological redraw, not adding more detail. Keep the original noble volcanic city composition and painted material quality.

cities.subtitle: Le jet du palais et la grande bulle
cities.description: Un jet lumineux parfaitement vertical relie la fleche du palais au sommet de la bulle, au-dessus de la cite sous-marine.
cities.request: Au sommet du batiment principal, un jet droit vertical vers la bulle ; conserver le reste.
cities.edit:
THALASSEA: A VERY LOCAL architectural-energy correction. Preserve the ENTIRE loved huge bubble, metropolis, main palace, external suburbs, capteurs, seabed, colors, light, camera and image framing. Change ONLY the central connection above the MAIN PALACE.
From the very tip of the central palace's HIGHEST SPIRE, send ONE CLEAR PERFECTLY STRAIGHT VERTICAL JET of luminous pearl-turquoise water/essence upward to the bubble membrane directly overhead. The jet is anchored exactly on the spire tip, a continuous narrow upright stream with a fine bright core and restrained painted fluid glow, visible at thumbnail size. It supports/feeds the bubble like a vertical fantasy fountain, NOT an angled thin wire or branching lightning. Source and upper membrane contact MUST have exactly the same horizontal coordinate in the image. Move the small upper contact node along the bubble surface to be DIRECTLY ABOVE the palace tip if necessary; do not move the palace or change the dome's outline to keep the previous off-axis node. The previous slanting line between palace and off-axis crown is rejected: remove it entirely and replace with the vertical jet. The jet terminates at a modest luminous ripple/node on the membrane and does NOT shoot outside the bubble into the sea above. No new tower, cannon, flag, sci-fi antenna, huge laser glow or extra jets. Keep the existing peripheral captor lines as secondary fine connections, never disguise an angled palace connection as vertical. All other areas remain the same. One exact coherent vertical energy/jet feature, same painterly Kalistar style.
